column1: # Game profile of Pokémon Sword (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.3.2 = v458752). Plays on the iPhone
# Game Freak's engine (the one before Trinity) on SDK 7.3.2, NVN, Wwise, Pia / NEX networking, with Silicon Studio's YEBIS post effects. The same sdk and movie module (subsdk0) builds as
# Super Mario Odyssey 1.4.1; subsdk1 is GLSLC, which main imports but never calls. Started from the provisional profile scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py wrote from its survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py)
# the camera is on the right stick
# No virtual address memory (the NPDM declares no system resource): nninitStartup sets a 3.13 GB heap in the 4 GB layout
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (main 25 MB of text, GLSLC 4.8 MB)
# 41,516 shaders: the BNSH entries of the 7,699 GFPAK archives under bin/archive (LZ4 entries, shader_split.py gfpak_members), the loose BNSH files of bin/battle, bin/graphics and
# system_resource/shader, two BNSH in main, and YEBIS's post effects, 3,155 shaders of a .tfxo file in a zlib stream in main (tfxo_streams)
